Question:
需求描述
功能需求
1. 模板名称唯一性校验
- 在创建新模板和修改现有模板时，系统需校验模板名称的唯一性
- 校验逻辑需排除当前正在修改的模板本身（允许保持原名称不变）
- 当检测到名称重复时，系统应返回明确的错误提示

2. 已发布模板修改限制
- 对于状态为"已发布"的模板，系统应禁止直接修改操作
- 需要提供明确的错误提示告知用户不可修改原因

技术规格
1. 错误码配置
- 新增模板名称已存在错误码(TEMPLATE_NAME_EXISTS)
- 需提供中英文的错误描述、原因说明、详细解释及解决建议

2. 数据库查询功能
- 新增按模板名称查询模板数据的DAO方法
- 需实现对应的Mapper映射和SQL查询语句

3. 单元测试要求
- 需覆盖以下测试场景：
- 创建模板时名称重复的情况
- 修改模板时名称重复的情况
- 修改已发布模板的情况
- 名称不冲突时的正常操作
- 数据库查询方法的正确性验证（存在/不存在两种情况）
build_command: 使用settings文件编译即可，需要去掉ssl校验
settings:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<settings xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/SETTINGS/1.0.0"
    xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
    xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/SETTINGS/1.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/settings-1.0.0.xsd">
    <localRepository>/root/.m2/repository</localRepository>
	<!-- pluginGroups
   | This is a list of additional group identifiers that will be searched when resolving plugins by their prefix, i.e.
   | when invoking a command line like "mvn prefix:goal". Maven will automatically add the group identifiers
   | "org.apache.maven.plugins" and "org.codehaus.mojo" if these are not already contained in the list.
   |-->
    <pluginGroups>
        <!-- pluginGroup
     | Specifies a further group identifier to use for plugin lookup.
    <pluginGroup>com.your.plugins</pluginGroup>
    -->
    </pluginGroups>
    <profiles>
        <profile>
            <id>gdd</id>
            <!-- >定义变量，pom.xml中distributionManagement会引用< -->
            <properties>
                <nexus.repositories.releases>https://cmc.centralrepo.rnd.huawei.com/artifactory/product_maven</nexus.repositories.releases>
                <nexus.repositories.snapshots>https://cmc.centralrepo.rnd.huawei.com/artifactory/product_maven</nexus.repositories.snapshots>
                <nexus.repositories.releases-3rd>https://maven.repo.cmc.tools.huawei.com/artifactory/maven-oss</nexus.repositories.releases-3rd>
                <nexus.repositories.snapshots-3rd>https://maven.repo.cmc.tools.huawei.com/artifactory/maven-oss</nexus.repositories.snapshots-3rd>
            </properties>
            <repositories>
                <!-- >Huawei自研release仓< -->
                <repository>
                    <id>central-huawei</id>
                    <name>central-huawei</name>
                    <url>https://cmc.centralrepo.rnd.huawei.com/artifactory/product_maven</url>
                    <releases>
                        <enabled>true</enabled>
                        <updatePolicy>always</updatePolicy>
                        <checksumPolicy>fail</checksumPolicy>
                    </releases>
                    <snapshots>
                        <enabled>true</enabled>
                        <updatePolicy>always</updatePolicy>
                        <checksumPolicy>fail</checksumPolicy>
                    </snapshots>
                </repository>
                <!-- >公司开源中心Maven仓,获取构建所需开源软件Jar包< -->
                <repository>
                    <id>centralrepo</id>
                    <name>central maven</name>
                    <url>https://cmc.centralrepo.rnd.huawei.com/artifactory/maven-central-repo/</url>
                    <releases>
                        <enabled>true</enabled>
                        <checksumPolicy>fail</checksumPolicy>
                    </releases>
                    <snapshots>
                        <enabled>false</enabled>
                        <checksumPolicy>fail</checksumPolicy>
                    </snapshots>
                </repository>
            </repositories>
            <pluginRepositories>
                <!-- >插件仓库< -->
                <pluginRepository>
                    <id>centralrepo</id>
                    <name>plugins repo</name>
                    <url>https://cmc.centralrepo.rnd.huawei.com/artifactory/maven-central-repo/</url>
                    <releases>
                        <enabled>true</enabled>
                        <checksumPolicy>fail</checksumPolicy>
                    </releases>
                    <snapshots>
                        <enabled>true</enabled>
                        <checksumPolicy>fail</checksumPolicy>
                    </snapshots>
                </pluginRepository>
                <pluginRepository>
                    <id>central-huawei</id>
                    <name>central-huawei</name>
                    <url>https://cmc.centralrepo.rnd.huawei.com/artifactory/product_maven</url>
                    <releases>
                        <enabled>true</enabled>
                        <updatePolicy>always</updatePolicy>
                        <checksumPolicy>fail</checksumPolicy>
                    </releases>
                    <snapshots>
                        <enabled>true</enabled>
                        <updatePolicy>always</updatePolicy>
                        <checksumPolicy>fail</checksumPolicy>
                    </snapshots>
                </pluginRepository>
            </pluginRepositories>
        </profile>
    </profiles>
    <mirrors>
        <mirror>
            <id>generic rep</id>
            <!--指定mirror源，避免遍历官方库-->
            <mirrorOf>*,!centralrepo,!central-huawei</mirrorOf>
            <name>local genericRep</name>
            <url>https://cmc.centralrepo.rnd.huawei.com/artifactory/maven-central-repo/</url>
        </mirror>
    </mirrors>
    <activeProfiles>
        <activeProfile>gdd</activeProfile>
    </activeProfiles>
</settings>
